key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to fetch new prices (in seconds). Default is 300 (5 minutes).

key.name: language
key.description: UI language: 'fa' for Persian, 'en' for English.

key.name: panel-ticker
key.description: Which asset price to display in the top panel indicator.

key.name: visible-assets
key.description: Array of asset IDs to show in the dropdown menu.

key.name: show-change-indicator
key.description: Whether to show the up/down arrow (▲/▼) and percentage change.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family for price display (e.g., 'Cantarell', 'Noto Sans', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Monospace').

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels for price display.
